```sparql
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dbp: <http://dbpedia.org/property/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?father ?fatherLabel WHERE {
  # Elizabeth Howard, Countess of Effingham
  dbr:Elizabeth_Howard,_Countess_of_Effingham dbp:spouse ?spouse .
  
  # Father of her spouse (father‑in‑law)
  ?spouse dbp:father ?father .
  
  OPTIONAL { ?father rdfs:label ?fatherLabel . FILTER (lang(?fatherLabel) = "en") }
}
LIMIT 100
```
